topics.description: A whistleblower from the Minnesota Department of Human Services (DHS) exposed alleged fraud under Governor Tim Walz. The whistleblower reportedly detailed a 'smear campaign' after reporting fraud concerns to the state.
topics.reason: Potential government fraud and whistleblower retaliation

topics.description: Newly released Epstein files show the FBI's investigation into possible sex trafficking. The files indicate the FBI concluded Jeffrey Epstein wasn't running a sex trafficking ring for powerful men.
topics.reason: Potential sex trafficking and FBI investigation
